scope: Offline synthetic reproductions against existing code; no production changes or accuracy benchmark

queue.harness: jsdom with simulated IntersectionObserver and bounding rectangles; response to one of two active requests released after third queued card moved offscreen

enable.harness: jsdom; boot with enabled false, deliver enabled true storage change, resolve first evaluation, append new visible card and wait 650 ms

fallback.harness: jsdom with innerText getter mapped to textContent; no known own-text selector; nested update-components-mini-update-v2 contains foreign marker
fallback.limitation: Isolates disconnected-clone node removal; not full Chrome rendering verification
